title: Advisory
description: One vulnerability advisory, as an OSV record: id, aliases, affected packages (purl and version ranges), severity and references. GHSA and NVD records are converted to OSV before they enter. The OSV schema is a pinned copy of release v1.9.2 of github.com/ossf/osv-schema (commit c8a57bdc5b0bc54646e140cabbb7834bd0b5aec9), licensed Apache-2.0; see NOTICE.
